column1: # C Programming Assessment 11 - Structs, Unions, Enums (CSV Format)
Below is your CSV data. **Copy everything from the code block below** and save it as a `.csv` file:
Weather Station Monitor,"**A weather monitoring system tracks atmospheric conditions:**

**What is the primary advantage of grouping weather measurements in a structure?**","Structures organize related weather measurements (temperature, humidity, wind_speed, conditions) into a single logical unit, making the data easier to manage and understand.",1,published,easy,understand,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Weather data is automatically validated for accuracy,All related measurements are organized under one data type,Memory usage is reduced compared to individual variables,Weather calculations are performed automatically,2
Recipe Ingredient List,"**A cooking app manages recipe ingredients with nutritional information:**

**What will be the output?**","The code accesses the protein field from the nested Nutrition structure using item.facts.protein, which contains the value 31.5.",1,published,easy,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Ingredient: Chicken has 250.0g protein,Ingredient: Chicken has 31.5g protein,Ingredient: 200.0 has 31.5g protein,Compilation error in nested structure access,2
Movie Theater Showtime,"**A movie theater system manages screening schedules:**

**What will be printed?**","The loop compares durations: Drama Story (135) > Action Hero (120) and Drama Story (135) > Comedy Night (95), so Drama Story is the longest.",1,published,medium,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Longest movie: Action Hero (120 min),Longest movie: Comedy Night (95 min),Longest movie: Drama Story (135 min),Longest movie: Action Hero (135 min),3
Fitness Activity Tracker,"**A fitness app tracks workout activities:**

**What will be the final calories value?**","log_activity() receives a copy, so the +50 doesn't affect the original (still 300). update_activity() receives a pointer and adds 50, making the final value 350.",1,published,medium,analyze,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Final calories: 300,Final calories: 350,Final calories: 400,Final calories: 250,2
Digital Display Controller,"**A digital display controller manages different value types:**

**Why does the number value change after setting the letter?**","Union members share the same memory location. When letter 'X' is stored, it overwrites the memory that previously held the number 42.",1,published,medium,understand,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Letter automatically converts to number format,Union members occupy the same memory space,Display controller prevents data conflicts,Number and letter are synchronized values,2
Pizza Order Status,"**A pizza delivery system tracks order status:**
printf(""Pizza is in the oven or beyond\n"")

**What will be the complete output?**","BAKING has value 300. The comparison 300 >= 300 is true, so both messages print.",1,published,easy,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,"Current status code: 300, Pizza is in the oven or beyond","Current status code: BAKING, Pizza is in the oven or beyond","Current status code: 3, Pizza is in the oven or beyond",Compilation error when comparing enum values,1
Smart Appliance Controller,"**A smart home system controls different appliance types:**

**What is the benefit of using a union for appliance settings?**","The union saves memory because each device needs only its specific settings (oven OR washer OR TV), not all possible settings for every device type.",1,published,medium,analyze,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,All appliance types can be controlled simultaneously,Memory is conserved by storing only relevant device settings,Settings are automatically synchronized across devices,Device malfunctions are automatically prevented,2
Vending Machine Selector,"**A vending machine uses enums for item selection:**
enum Item { SODA, CHIPS, CANDY, WATER }

**What will be printed?**","selection is set to CHIPS (value 1), so the switch executes the CHIPS case, printing ""Dispensing snack"".",1,published,easy,apply,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Dispensing beverage,Dispensing snack,Dispensing sweet,Invalid selection,2
Pet Adoption Center,"**A pet adoption center manages animal information:**
enum Species { CAT = 1, DOG = 2, BIRD = 3, RABBIT = 4 }

**How do enums enhance this pet management system?**","Using CAT, DOG, BIRD, RABBIT instead of numbers (1, 2, 3, 4) makes the code more readable and self-documenting when identifying pet species.",1,published,easy,understand,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Enums automatically track pet adoption status,Pet species are more readable than numeric codes,Enums prevent pets from being assigned wrong ages,Species information is automatically validated,2
Music Streaming Platform,"**A music streaming platform manages audio tracks with different formats:**
enum AudioFormat { MP3 = 128, FLAC = 1411, AAC = 256, OGG = 320 }

**What design approach does this music platform demonstrate?**","Enums provide meaningful audio format constants with bitrate values (FLAC=1411), while unions efficiently store format-specific information without wasting memory on unused format fields.",1,published,hard,analyze,blank,c-programming,blank,blank,blank,Using enums for audio quality levels and unions for format-specific data,Using unions to play multiple audio formats simultaneously,Using structures to automatically convert between audio formats,Using enums to compress audio file sizes,1
